explanation_short: The incremental feature analysis shows that KNN achieved its best performance with 9 features, resulting in an R² of 0.83014 and an MSE of 0.011901.
explanation_full: The incremental feature analysis, detailed in the table, indicates that the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) model achieved its optimal performance when using 9 features. This feature set, comprising 'VFA -> Butyrate -> Acetate -> VSS -> Propionate -> Ethanol -> COD-O -> pH -> ORP_Low', yielded the highest R² score of 0.83014 and the lowest Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 0.011901. This suggests that adding the 9th feature provided the most significant boost to model predictive power compared to adding fewer or more features.
